$comment: How the map uses real-time data, for every region (packages/transit-core/src/config.ts → resolveRt): client polling, bus prediction and carried delays. An operator (operator.json → rt) overrides prediction, carry and detourNearM, as they depend on its buses and data; a region (config/regions/<id>/rt.json) anything, e.g. client polling. How often each feed is polled, and the thresholds that follow from it, are the feed's (feed.json → realtime). Tuned on TransLink's 99 and RapidBus (config/regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #25).
$clientPollS: The browser polls the live endpoint (GET /regions/<id>/live/transit) at most this often; it is also the endpoint's longest edge-cache time. Guess.
$clientPollMaxS: ...and at least this often, even when the server expects no new data sooner (its nextAt). Guess.
$clientPollSlackS: The browser polls this long after the server's nextAt, so the poll or AIS batch it waits for has landed. A positions poll usually answers within 1-3 s (guess).
$detourNearM: A bus off its route while a TransLink detour alert covers it counts as on detour only within this distance of a stop the alert lists (guess; long-running detours would otherwise switch off shifted-GPS handling route-wide). See config/regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #28.
$prediction: Live bus prediction and learned travel-time profiles (packages/transit-core/src/rt/profile.ts, packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#buses). Values are guesses tuned against recorded data with pipelines/eval-rt.ts unless noted; see config/regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #25.

prediction.$bandStartHours: Time-of-day bands: night, AM peak, midday, PM peak, evening (local hours).
prediction.$stationaryM: GPS noise on a standing bus is ~5-10 m (measured: recorded fixes).
prediction.$stopExcessM: Slow time within this of a stop (vs the median pace of bins away from stops within baselineWindowM) is counted as dwell, since 30 s fixes smear dwells into nearby bins. Tuned with pipelines/eval-rt.ts (2026-09-26): 75 m gives dwells of p25/p50/p75 22/32/45 s (plausible for RapidBus stops at signals) for ~2 m median / ~12 m p90 more error at 60 s than 0 m (no concentration, where buses visibly don't stop); 150 m costs 5/30 m.
prediction.$paceWeight: Tuned on 8 h training / 3 h test (2026-09-26): adapting to the bus's recent pace (any window 180-1200 s) made 30-90 s predictions slightly worse, so it's off. Re-tested 2026-10-12 on 311 h of production recordings at the real cadence: 0.3 is 3-8 % worse at 150-300 s on a weekday and a Sunday (0.6 worse still), better only on Thanksgiving Monday.
prediction.$catchUpMps: Glide: tuned with pipelines/eval-rt.ts (2026-09-26): 8 m/s over ≤ 25 s keeps apparent speed p99 ≈ 24 m/s for ~1 m of median accuracy vs 12 m/s / 15 s.
prediction.$scheduleAnchorS: Schedule estimates for buses: TransLink gives every stop a time, interpolated between timepoints; pin to the timetable at most every this many seconds and let the profile place stops and slow sections in between. Guess.
prediction.$profileHistoryDays: build:rt-profile learns from this many days of recorded history (guess: long enough for weekday and weekend patterns, short enough to follow road changes, and to build in minutes on the server).

$carry: Carrying RT bus delays into schedule estimates (packages/transit-core/src/rt/carry.ts). Guesses; see config/regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #25.
